data.body: Close readiness update after Seahorse landed: blocker AC7 is now satisfied by prenatal-maudlin-seahorse Gerrit 2824 merged as 84e94070c819934e053f8883b4719cd215b14d7d, which provides the rebar-side duplicate-title plus creation-volume detector without depending on Jira query size. AC8 is satisfied: `gh workflow list --all` reports Reconcile Bridge active. Raven class fix remains merged as d92d97b096b4a064d66cff1023e78711c0ba1620; targeted Raven regression tests (test_init_fail_closed.py, test_plan_replay_tier2.py, test_echo_loop_experiment.py) pass, and full make verify with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* unset passed on current HEAD 826d09b4e6327c82ecf7387479b1eac682fc5b4f. Marking AC1-AC8 complete for closure; no force used.
